context:
Goal: no PR that passed review sits idle.
Problem (goal): lanes finish faster than batches merge. The coordinator keeps starting lanes while reviewed PRs pile up, so it needs your limit.
Based on (notes): the coordinator's scan at 21:35 CST counts 215 reviewed PRs waiting, 142 of them finished in the last 6 h. No tool has checked this count yet.
Based on (notes): 26 batch merges in 45 h, with 1-5 lanes in each (same scan).
Departs from: main, where the coordinator starts every ready step at once (rule parallelism-keep-going) — new lanes wait while the reviewed queue is above a limit, except safety fixes and your asks.
Meanwhile: the coordinator starts no new lanes except safety fixes and your asks.

options.gain: Batches catch up, and no new work piles on.
options.how: New lanes wait while 50 or more reviewed PRs wait to merge. Safety fixes and your asks still start.
options.label: Hold new lanes until fewer than 50 reviewed PRs wait (recommended)
options.lose: Ready steps wait, so gap fixes land later.

options.how: The same hold, with a limit of 20.
options.label: Hold new lanes until fewer than 20 wait

options.how: Lanes start as today. The batch runner puts more lanes in each batch.
options.label: No hold, bigger batches only

ref: steps pr-backlog-clear and pr-state-is-on-the-pr; rule parallelism-keep-going
short: Hold new lanes while the merge queue is long
title: Should new lanes wait while too many reviewed PRs wait to merge?
why: The coordinator recommends a: the queue is past 200, and a limit of 50 lets batches catch up without stopping all work.
